fun_facts: Xavier Hutchinson’s hometown is Jacksonville, Florida.
In 2021, Xavier Hutchinson caught 83 passes, an Iowa State single-season record; he also had 987 receiving yards and five touchdowns.
In a game against Texas, Xavier Hutchinson caught eight passes for 96 yards and also threw a 49-yard touchdown pass.
At one point in his college career, Xavier Hutchinson had caught at least one pass in each of his first 26 games.

# Iowa State dominates second half, rolls past Texas 30-7

By AP

Nov 7, 2021, 12:15 am

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

AMES, Iowa -- —

The running of [Breece Hall](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4427366/breece-hall) and a little razzle-dazzle propelled Iowa State to a 30-7 victory over Texas at Jack Trice Stadium on Saturday.

Hall rushed for 136 yards and two touchdowns as the Cyclones (6-3, 4-2 Big 12) earned their third straight win over the Longhorn and became bowl eligible for the fifth consecutive season.

It was the sixth time in seven games Hall has gone of the 100-yard mark.

“I may be biased,” receiver [Xavier Hutchinson](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4686422/xavier-hutchinson) said, “but to me Breece is the best back in college football.”

Hutchinson caught eight passes for Iowa State, totaling 96 yards. He also threw a 49-yard touchdown pass.
